# Areas

*Describes silverpoint 0.7.0.*

3 charts. Shared props, the data shapes and the recommender are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md).

**Contents:** [AreaChart](#areachart) · [RangeBandChart](#rangebandchart) · [StreamChart](#streamchart)

## AreaChart

`area-chart` · A curved, toned area under its line.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `AreaChart` | `SpAreaChart` | `sp-area-chart` | `area_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/area-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/area-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/area-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `series`; intents `trend`, `change`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| x | `xKey` | string | yes |
| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "x": "Mon", "value": 32 }, { "x": "Tue", "value": 45 }, { "x": "Wed", "value": 41 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xKey` | `Accessor<string \| number>` | `'x'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `curve` | `LineCurve` | `'monotone'` |  |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { AreaChart } from '@silverpoint/react/area-chart';

export function AreaChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <AreaChart
      data={rows}
      xKey="x"
      valueKey="value"
      title="Area chart"
    />
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { SpAreaChart } from '@silverpoint/vue/area-chart';

defineProps<{ rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SpAreaChart
    :data="rows"
    xKey="x"
    valueKey="value"
    title="Area chart"
  />
</template>
```

```ts angular
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, input } from '@angular/core';
import { SpAreaChart } from '@silverpoint/angular/area-chart';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-area-chart-view',
  imports: [SpAreaChart],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sp-area-chart
      [data]="rows()"
      [xKey]="'x'"
      [valueKey]="'value'"
      [title]="'Area chart'"
    />
  `,
})
export class AreaChartView {
  readonly rows = input.required<readonly Record<string, unknown>[]>();
}
```

## RangeBandChart

`range-band-chart` · The band between a low and a high series.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `RangeBandChart` | `SpRangeBandChart` | `sp-range-band-chart` | `range_band_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/range-band-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/range-band-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/range-band-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `intervals`; intents `uncertainty`, `trend`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| x | `xKey` | string | yes |
| low | `lowKey` | number | yes |
| high | `highKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "x": "Mon", "low": 11, "high": 19 }, { "x": "Tue", "low": 12, "high": 22 }, { "x": "Wed", "low": 14, "high": 24 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xKey` | `Accessor<string \| number>` | `'x'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `lowKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'low'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `highKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'high'` | Ignored without `data`. |

## StreamChart

`stream-chart` · Two waves, overlaid or stacked.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `StreamChart` | `SpStreamChart` | `sp-stream-chart` | `stream_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/stream-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/stream-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/stream-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `series`; intents `trend`, `part-to-whole`, `compare`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| x | `xKey` | string | yes |
| values | `keys` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows (read through 0="organic", 1="paid"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "x": "Mon", "organic": 22, "paid": 14 }, { "x": "Tue", "organic": 28, "paid": 18 }, { "x": "Wed", "organic": 35, "paid": 16 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xKey` | `Accessor<string \| number>` | `'x'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `keys` | `readonly string[]` |  | Ignored without `data`. |
| `stacked` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';

}
```
